content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-GPU CUDA Fortran port의 compilation variants, device/global/constant/shared memory, kernel launch geometry, inner-tile stencil, streams, rank-device mapping, staged MGPU halo exchange, MGPU Thomas boundary exchange, cuSPARSE batched solver를 source lines로 설명한 노트이다(1-239행). 단일-GPU Blackwell Makefile과 legacy CUDA10.1 original/MGPU variants를 대비하고(23-37행), 16x16/14x14 tiles, 2D launches, 1-thread-per-row Thomas, naive transpose, compiler-generated kernels를 열거한다(41-138행). Nine streams, 80% memory guard, MPI vector types, cudaMemcpy2D staging, periodic exchange, asynchronous coefficient pipeline, gtsv2 workspace allocation을 추적한다(142-232행).
entities: mod_cuda global device, constant, shared state (lines 41-54)
naive matrix transpose for X Thomas (lines 100-110)
compiler-generated CUF kernels and MPI CFL reduction (lines 112-116)
AssignDevice local-rank GPU mapping and CudaMemUse guard (lines 154-168)
MGPU derived datatypes and staged real/integer halo exchange (lines 172-197)
MGPU periodic exchange and tridiagonal coefficient pipeline (lines 199-213)
TriSolver branch and cuSPARSE gtsv2 batch workspace (lines 217-232)

calls: triDx and triDy forward sweeps launch in streamID(2/3) (lines 93-98)
transpose_kernel runs before and after X Thomas (lines 103-110)
MPI_ALLREDUCE computes global minimum CFL under MGPU (line 114)
cudaSetDevice(dev) maps local rank to GPU (lines 161-162)
cudaMemGetInfo and MPI min/max memory reductions (lines 167-168)
MPI_TYPE_VECTOR creates/commits HaloWE/HaloSN integer and real types (lines 177-182)
MPI_IRECV → async H2D → Thomas sweep → async D2H → stream synchronize → MPI_ISEND (lines 201-211)
unresolved: Blackwell port updates only Makefile_cuda to nvfortran/cc120 (lines 31, 37), while Makefile_mgpu remains FC=mpif90 with -Mcuda=cuda10.1 (line 33). Therefore the described MGPU path is not shown as compatible with the CUDA12+/Blackwell requirement that motivated the port.

CUDA runtime cudaMemcpy2D pitch and width arguments are described and passed as Mloc/Nghost element counts (lines 188-193). The API normally specifies pitches and width in bytes; no multiplication by real/integer element size or Fortran overload semantics is shown, creating a byte-vs-element unit mismatch risk for all staged halo copies.

device selection uses dev=newRank without querying device count or taking a modulo (lines 159-162). More MPI ranks than GPUs on a node can pass an out-of-range device id before the later memory guard.

cudaMemcpy2dAsync is claimed to overlap X/Y exchanges (lines 201-210), but rmsgx/smsgx host buffers are not identified as pinned/page-locked. Without pinned host memory the copy may serialize or fail to provide the claimed overlap.

the MGPU tridiagonal snippet receives and sends 2*Nloc MPI_SP elements but the visible cudaMemcpy2D copies only Nloc by one row for myDx_T (lines 201-206). The omitted ellipsis may contain the second coefficient copy; the displayed interface does not account for all transferred elements.
edge ranks change sweep start to Ibeg+1/Jbeg+1 when MPI_PROC_NULL (line 212). No boundary equation is given to show why skipping the first interior index is correct rather than an off-by-one loss.

inner-tile output covers 14 cells per block, but this section does not show breaking_kernel's launch grid denominator (lines 122-136). If the grid were sized with 16 rather than Inner=14, the domain tail would be uncovered.
CudaMemUse checks >80% only after cudaMemGetInfo and is described as warning+STOP (lines 167-168); return status, totalMem=0, and allocation-failure handling are not given.

the note describes a source read and mechanisms but no multi-GPU execution result, halo numerical comparison, or stream-race test. MGPU correctness remains unvalidated within this file (lines 154-213).
